capabilities.local_comparison: Compare two local controller solves at the same saved state/previous input/horizon with exactly one adopted weight change. Measures local plan/endpoint differences; does not establish closed-loop settling or causal attribution. Requires a saved effective horizon matching the authorized horizon.
capabilities.prediction_braking: At one saved projected state, compare recorded input with instantaneous braking-box input over the fixed short horizon. Can measure local endpoint speed/position differences. Cannot separate objective weighting, seed selection, horizon effects or backend-model mismatch when they predict the same result; cannot identify the dominant settling cause.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.
inventory.claim_policy: Use inventory plus your receipt ledger: not_displayed, not_read in this context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained, or retained_unavailable through a named capability. A sampled view or failed raw gzip read does not prove absence.

memory_policy.policy: Reconstruct system instructions plus structured state; no chronological conversation replay.
memory_policy.retention: Own accepted handoff products FIFO; oversized products retain reference only. Existing recent evidence pages and last four actions stay within their original host limits. Phase changes preserve these in the same context.
memory_policy.separation: single_context shares one memory across phases; dual_context keeps one per role and receives explicit current request/report/response/feedback handoffs.

scope: Retained-evidence reads within the design read allowance: inventory entries source.one_step_predictions, source.applied_tensions, source.saved_projected_states, source.plan_selection, source.solver_status, source.controller_horizon, and source.force_limits, plus the sampled source.backend_motion motion view. Report coverage per entry and, for partially read entries, describe the queried subset and mark the remainder not_read in this context.

Explicitly authorized saved-state numerical work only as granted by the host for this subject: prediction_braking at one saved projected state and local_comparison at one saved state with exactly one adopted weight change, under the host grant's model.gvs@1.0.0, implicit_euler, horizon_s 0.01, integration_step_s 0.002, max_checks 1, and numerical_limits local_solves<=6, prediction_evaluations<=24; saved_state_or_temporary_analysis configuration scope only.
Excluded: any production or controller change, backend re-execution, closed-loop counterfactual replay, and any claim of a dominant causal root cause; these require separate authority.
Excluded from readable evidence: source.historical_full_plans (full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces), which the inventory reports as not retained.
Frames and templates as recorded: world for tip vectors, projected GVS coordinates for state; input pointer template f{b9a05ccabc3a} and state pointer template f{14bf4f302db0}.
stopping_conditions: Stop and deliver when the design read allowance (2 read turns) is exhausted, or when additional retained reads return no further relevant records for the question.

Stop when the bounded local_comparison or prediction_braking result yields endpoint differences too small or ambiguous to separate solver/deadline degradation, plan-selection or warm-start drift, and objective-weighting effects.

Stop if required evidence is not retained or not displayed (for example historical full plans or full snapshots fd78b9eed95db); state it as not retained or not displayed rather than inferring absence.
Stop when the phase model-call limit (3) is reached, or when the question is answered well enough to hand off, whichever comes first.
request_content.subject: control

scheduling: Synchronous controller calls complete before fixed-count backend steps; wall deadline misses do not inject physical delay into simulated time.

limitations: No historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed.
Single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause.
